description:
About the job

About the Team

The Consumer Performance Marketing team owns the execution of paid social acquisition across Meta, TikTok, and Snapchat. We operate at scale across the U.S. and Canada, managing complex builds, pacing routines, live optimizations, QA workflows, and experiment cycles that directly impact consumer growth.

We work closely with U.S.-based Channel Managers, Creative, Analytics, and Martech, functioning as one integrated performance engine. This requires strong operational discipline, fast signal interpretation, and a mindset focused on translating platform behavior into clear, actionable steps.

While the team is execution-heavy, we also influence strategy by shaping testing agendas, surfacing insights, and partnering with platform reps on betas and new product rollouts. It's a high-ownership environment for operators who thrive in fast, data-driven systems.

About the Role

This role owns the tactical execution of Consumer paid social campaigns end-to-end. You will build, QA, pace, optimize, and iterate campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and Snap, managing multi-million-dollar budgets with precision.

You'll partner with U.S. teams and platform reps to run experiments, test new bidding approaches, evaluate audience structures, and support creative testing. You will also be expected to diagnose issues quickly, communicate insights clearly, and maintain structurally sound accounts.

This position requires someone who can execute with technical depth, think analytically, and move fast — ensuring each optimization ties directly to performance outcomes.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…


Be a part of our first DoorDash team in our Mexico City office! 
Manage multi-million dollar monthly digital budgets across digital paid marketing channels, working with partners such as Meta, Snap, Google and TikTok to optimize campaign performance and test new products.
Learn to operate a world-class acquisition program that brings in millions of orders to DoorDash, making it the top food delivery and logistics platform in the U.S.. working with our U.S. based
Maintain and monitor key metrics across channels including budget pacing, cost per acquisition and LTV proxies.
Manage an experimentation roadmap to optimize performance including A/B creative tests, incrementality tests, and bidding algo tests
Work closely with other teams and stakeholders to ensure goals are met


We're excited about you because…


You are proficient in the English language 
You have a proven track record in the performance marketing space, with 4+ years of experience.
Direct, hands-on experience managing media buying, optimization (Paid Social), and strategic planning either at an agency or in-house
You are highly proficient in Excel/Google Sheets and have deep familiarity with metrics such as CPA, CPC, CVR, and LTV.
Strong quantitative, analytical and problem-solving skills; must be very comfortable with data analysis and able to use data to make decisions and conduct experiments.
Experience with Web & App Tracking/Attribution (preferred)
Knowledge of SQL (preferred)
Experience working on multi-sided marketplace businesses (preferred)


About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Creator Manager - TikTok Shop
description:
About the job

Responsibilities
Team Intro
The commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated.
With millions of loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join our operations team, together we can build an commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure and intuitive for our users.

We are looking for a passionate and strategic Creator Manager to join our team. You will be responsible for discovering, incubating, and educating e-commerce creators, with a focus on helping vertical creators improve their sales performance. You will collaborate closely with industry teams to match high-potential creators with quality content formats, including short videos and live streaming. Additionally, you will support major campaigns, marketing initiatives, and creator education efforts by providing relevant content and guidance. A key part of your role will be working with the content moderation team to educate creators on platform policies and ensure compliance. 

Responsibilities: 
- Identify, onboard, and incubate e-commerce creators within specific verticals to drive sales growth. 
- Develop and implement strategies to scale creator success, leveraging data insights to guide decision-making. 
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Category, Marketing, Campaign operations) to match creators with suitable content opportunities and promotional activities. 
- Provide ongoing education and support to creators, helping them optimize content strategy, understand platform rules, and improve performance. 
- Work with the content moderation team to ensure creators adhere to platform guidelines and policies.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
- Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable plans. 
- Service-oriented mindset, patience, and excellent communication skills to support and educate creators. 
- Fast learner who can quickly absorb information and effectively teach others. 
- Team player with a strong sense of responsibility and a positive, can-do attitude. 
- Proficient in data analysis and comfortable using metrics to drive decisions. 
 
Preferred Qualifications:
- 3+ years of experience in operations or partner management
- Able to establish contact, build up trust with creators, and provide complete support on platform training, creator engagement activities.

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.


TikTok Accommodation
TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request

title: Team Lead, Agency Growth Sales, SpLATAM - Mexico
description:
About the job

Responsibilities
At TikTok, our Global Business Solutions (GBS) team plays a key role in generating revenue by promoting our advertising solutions, onboarding new clients, driving ad campaigns, and more. As the TikTok community grows at an unprecedented speed around the world, our GBS team leads groundbreaking projects that are changing the landscape of the advertising industry in real time.

About the team:
TikTok's Agency Sales team is at the forefront of connecting agencies of all sizes with TikTok's creative ecosystem — helping them unlock performance, build compelling narratives for their clients, and grow sustainably on the platform. Our team operates at the intersection of business strategy, product expertise, and client partnership.

The LATAM Agency team is a high-growth, high-impact environment where no two days are the same. We move fast, think big, and win together.

About the role:
We are looking for an experienced Team Lead to head our Agency Sales function across Latin America. This is a player-coach role: you will manage and mentor a team of Agency Partner Managers while also owning strategic relationships with our most critical agency partners in the region.

You will be responsible for driving revenue growth, developing the agency ecosystem, and representing TikTok as the go-to performance and brand-building platform for agencies across Brazil & SpLATAM markets including Mexico, Colombia, Argentina. You will be a key voice in shaping regional strategy, go-to-market motions, and long-term agency enablement programs.

This role requires an experience leader with deep knowledge of the LATAM agency landscape, a proven track record of exceeding revenue targets, and the ability to inspire and develop high-performing teams in a hyper-growth environment.

In-Office Policy - We are currently working in the office 4x a week in Polanco and will be moving to full-time, 5 days in-office by September 2026.

*Please submit your resume in English in order to be considered*

Responsibilities:
1) Team Leadership & People Development
- Lead, coach, and develop a team of Agency Partner Managers across region, fostering a high-performance culture rooted in accountability, creativity, and commercial rigor.
- Set clear team objectives, track performance against KPIs, and provide structured feedback and development plans to support individual growth.
- Recruit, onboard, and retain top commercial talent as the team scales.
- Serve as a role model for consultative selling, strategic account management, and cross-functional collaboration.

2) Revenue & Business Growth
- Own and drive the team's revenue targets across the SMB agency segment in LATAM, with accountability for both top-line growth and portfolio health metrics.
- Identify, prioritize, and develop strategic agency partnerships — including independent agencies, regional networks, and in-market holding company affiliates.
- Architect and execute scaled engagement models that allow the team to grow agency revenue efficiently across a large and diverse book of business.
- Build and manage a robust pipeline of new agency acquisition opportunities, translating market trends into actionable growth strategies.

3) Agency Partnerships & Enablement
- Build deep, strategic relationships with C-level and high-level stakeholders at top agencies 
- Lead executive business reviews (QBRs) and joint business planning sessions with key agency partners to align on growth roadmaps and investment strategies.
- Develop and oversee structured agency education and certification programs, ensuring partners are fluent in TikTok product solutions, creative best practices, and full-funnel strategies.
- Champion TikTok's value proposition externally, representing the platform at industry events, agency summits, and partner forums across the region.

4) Strategy & Cross-Functional Influence
- Serve as the primary voice-of-the-market for LATAM agency insights, providing structured feedback to Product, Marketing, and Operations to shape platform priorities and scaled solutions.
- Partner closely with cross-functional teams including Global Sales Excellence, Marketing, Trust & Safety, and Ops to design and execute regional go-to-market initiatives.
- Develop data-driven strategic narratives and market analysis to inform leadership decisions and regional investment priorities.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
- Years of experience in digital advertising, media sales, or agency partnerships, with at least 3 years in a team leadership or management role.
- Deep, firsthand knowledge of the LATAM agency ecosystem — including the leading independent agencies, regional holding company structures, and the key decision-makers shaping client investment across major markets.
- Demonstrated track record of exceeding revenue targets and growing complex, multi-stakeholder agency relationships in a fast-paced commercial environment.
- Proven ability to coach and develop commercial talent, with experience building and scaling high-performing sales teams.
- High written and oral proficiency in Spanish and English is required due to frequent communications with stakeholders based in Spanish-speaking markets".
- Strong command of the digital advertising ecosystem — including performance marketing, programmatic, social, and full-funnel planning — with the ability to credibly advise high-level agency leaders.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience at a social media, digital platform, or ad tech company, ideally working directly with or within agencies at a leadership level.
- Familiarity with TikTok's advertising solutions, including TikTok for Business, Shop Ads, and performance-based products.
- Knowledge of auction-based and programmatic ad products, and experience translating product complexity into commercial narratives for agency audiences.
- Experience designing and leading scaled agency enablement programs such as certification tracks, partner academies, or structured QBR frameworks.
- Strong executive presence with the ability to engage C-suite stakeholders both externally (agency partners) and internally (TikTok leadership).
- Passion for TikTok's mission and a genuine curiosity about creator culture, short-form content trends, and the evolving role of social commerce in LATAM.
- Entrepreneurial mindset — comfortable building from the ground up, iterating quickly, and driving clarity in ambiguous, high-growth environments.

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.


TikTok Accommodation
TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

successfully influence without authority

description:
About the job

Who We Are Is What We Do.

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly.

Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.

Why should you be part of our success story?

As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.

Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google.

Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.

The role

We are hiring a Staff Product Manager to own product across one of our largest and most strategic business lines. You will report directly to a Head of Product, own the outcomes of two to three teams, and partner closely with senior leadership, including our CEO, on the strategy and roadmap.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You will not manage PMs day-to-day, but you will set the standard for product craft on your teams and shape the trajectory of a business line that generates a material share of our revenue.

What You Will Do


Own the product strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for two to three teams within a core business line.
Ship at pace. Deel operates at a velocity most companies find uncomfortable, and we like it that way.
Reduce complexity in existing flows. Our product has grown fast and needs sharp product thinking to unwind accumulated friction.
Partner deeply with engineering, design, operations, and commercial leaders to make big calls on scope, pace, and tradeoffs.
Operate in a regulated environment and with people’s pay, where getting things wrong has real consequences for our customers, for people’s livelihood, and for Deel.
Instrument your flows. You will be expected to know your funnel numbers cold and defend product decisions in front of a CEO who reads the same dashboards you do.
Bring an AI-native workflow to how you build product, and ship features that use AI to collapse workflows for our customers.


What We Are Looking For


8+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time at senior levels (Senior PM and above).
A shipping track record in a regulated environment. Fintech, payments, marketplaces at scale, healthtech, or compliance-heavy global B2B SaaS are all strong signals.
Sharp growth instincts. You think in funnels, conversion, and drop-off, and you have made numbers move.
Strong compliance intuition. You have designed around KYC, GDPR, country-specific regulation, or similar, and you do not treat legal as an afterthought.
Executive presence. You can hold your own in front of a CEO and other C-suite leaders. You get to the point, defend your calls, and change your mind fast when the data says so.
Bias to action and comfort with ambiguity. You do not need a fully-formed spec to start.
Excellent asynchronous operator. Our engineering base is EMEA and LATAM heavy, and this role coordinates across multiple time zones.


Bonus points


Experience with HRIS-adjacent products.
Direct experience at a hyperscaling private company (Series C onwards).
Prior founder or 0-to-1 product experience.
Fluent Portuguese or Spanish.


Where you can be based

EMEA, LATAM (especially Brazil), or US East Coast. This role has meaningful overlap requirements with our EMEA and Brazil engineering teams. US West Coast is not suitable for this position.

What You Will Get


Competitive compensation, calibrated to your level. We are hiring at Senior, Staff, and Principal levels, and we will level to the person.
Meaningful equity.
The autonomy and support to ship at your maximum pace.
Direct access to our CEO and senior leadership team on the products you own.
A team of exceptional engineers, designers, and operators to build with.


How We Hire

Our process is fast, respectful, and consistent. Five stages, running end to end in two to three weeks.


Recruiter screen (30 minutes).
Hiring manager conversation (45 minutes).
Live 90-minute case study, worked through together with the hiring team. You will get the prompt 5 minutes before, prep for 30 minutes, then work with us for an hour. AI is allowed and encouraged.
Cross-functional interview (30mins)
Final conversation with CEO (20mins)


We will respect your time throughout and give you a clear answer, either way, quickly.

Applications close September 18th

Total Rewards

Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all.


Our salary range reflects gross base salary. For commercial roles with commission eligibility, this figure represents On-Target Earnings (OTE), inclusive of base salary and target commission.
Salary ranges are quoted in USD as a consistent global reference. Your offer will be localized to your country's currency using a market-aligned conversion.
Final pay is based on objective, job-related criteria including experience, skills, and location.
We don't ask about salary history. Offers are based on the role and what you bring to it.


Some things you'll enjoy


Stock grant opportunities dependent on your role, employment status and location
Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country
The flexibility of remote work, including optional WeWork access


At Deel, we're an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy or maternity or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Unless otherwise agreed, we will communicate with job applicants using Deel-specific emails, which include @deel.com and other acquired company emails like @payspace.com and @paygroup.com. You can view the most up-to-date job listings at Deel by visiting our careers page.

Deel welcomes persons with disabilities to apply to any of our open roles. We will provide application and/or interview accommodations on request throughout the recruitment, selection and assessment process for applicants with disabilities or other needs. If you require application and/or interview accommodations, please inform our Talent Acquisition Team via email (recruiting@deel.com) and a team member will be in touch to ensure your equal participation.

As part of our hiring process, we primarily rely on interviews and role-related assessments. In limited cases, we may also consider informal background information relevant to the role, in line with our privacy and fairness obligations.

This application process may utilise Automated Employment Decision Tools (AEDT) and AI systems to assist in evaluating candidates based on experience level, technical skills and qualifications. This processing is conducted in compliance with applicable Data Protection, AI Governance and Labour Laws. We ensure human oversight is maintained in all final hiring decisions. Ready to be part of the experience?

Utilizing your skills, experience and passion for customer service to help propel your team and its business partners to success.

Responsibilities

What would you do every day as a Customer Care Professional? 


 Consistently deliver extraordinary service on a high volume of inbound calls in a fast-paced, structured, customer care environment with a keen focus on driving a Customer First mentality. 
 Consult with Card Members to understand their needs and tailor unique and personal solutions for them, while also reinforcing the benefits of card membership and acknowledging Card Member tenure. 
 Add value for our customers through unexpected relevant recommendations of product offers/ benefit enrollments that deepen customer engagement and loyalty. 
 Utilize your “service oriented” personality to develop key selling skills to optimize and solidify the customer relationship by deepening their loyalty to our brand. 
 Address general and account-specific customer inquiries- statement inquiries, card replacement, make payments, rewards redemption, etc., and update customer account information. 
 Use tools and resources to identify custom solutions and anticipate customer needs, in our commitment to maintain a first point of contact resolution. 
 Meet and exceed performance goals that include, but are not limited to: sales rates, quality goals, compliance regulations and productivity targets, & customer performance metrics. 


Qualifications


 Strong written and communication skills to be able to converse effectively and naturally in English and Spanish with our Card Members to deepen client relationships and drive satisfaction. 
 Resilience needed to efficiently manage a steady stream of customer calls, while balancing performance to meet a variety of metrics, and remain positive through change and stressful situations. 
 Ability to showcase humility and show care and appreciation through emotional acknowledgement of our customer queries/situations on each call. 
 Technical savvy to multi-task and navigate through multiple computer systems and applications, simultaneously, with speed and accuracy. 
 Integrity to manage sensitive Card Member information and adhere to all Regulatory and Compliance guidelines related to servicing and sales practices. 
 Driven to please by providing the ultimate experience for our Card Members on every interaction. 
 Timeliness and reliability. 


Preferred Skills


 Passion for building customer loyalty through exceptional listening, consultative relationship building, resourcefulness and problem solving skills. 
 Customer service and consultative sales environment experience preferred. 
 Passion for consultative sales, recommending products or solutions tailored to each customer. 
 Ability to adapt communication style to a wide variety of personalities and situations and take ownership and responsibility for each call, from beginning to end. 


Additional Requirements


 Flexibility to work from Monday to Sunday anytime between 6:00 am-12:00 am. 
 Hybrid Environment- on site expectation 3 days/week. 
 Workplace Flexibility: Full time. Shift flexibility requirements. 
 American Express offers a fantastic and diverse working environment. High performance is rewarded with target driven incentives. 


About Us

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

About The Team

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:


Competitive base salaries
Flexible work arrangements and schedules with hybrid and virtual options with Amex Flex
Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
Free and confidential counselling support through our Healthy Minds program
Career development and training opportunities


Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

title: Analista Servicio a Cliente, eHubs
description:
About the job

Empresa:

eHubs es una empresa especializada en desarrollar y operar una red de inmuebles de hiper proximidad, permitiendo que las marcas se acerquen físicamente a sus clientes.

Rol:

Gestionar y desarrollar las cuentas clave de la compañía, trabajando de manera coordinada con el equipo directivo para consolidar y fortalecer las relaciones comerciales con los clientes. Será el principal punto de contacto en el día a día, responsable de dar seguimiento a las cuentas existentes y a las oportunidades en pipeline, asegurando el cierre de nuevos negocios, la renovación de contratos y el crecimiento de las cuentas mediante una atención cercana, estratégica y orientada a resultados.

Principales Funciones:

1. Gestión de oportunidades

Dar seguimiento a las oportunidades comerciales hasta su cierre, incluyendo propuestas, visitas a sitio, negociaciones y formalización de contratos.

Elaborar propuestas comerciales y cotizaciones alineadas a los objetivos.

Coordinar el proceso de cierre con clientes y áreas internas involucradas.

2. Renovación y desarrollo de cuentas

Gestionar oportunamente las renovaciones de contratos.

Identificar oportunidades de crecimiento mediante nuevos espacios, ubicaciones o servicios.

Fortalecer la relación con los clientes para impulsar su fidelización y generar nuevas oportunidades de negocio.

3. Coordinación y atención al cliente

Ser el enlace principal entre el cliente y las áreas internas para asegurar una atención oportuna.

Coordinar con Operaciones, Legal, Finanzas, Mantenimiento y proveedores la correcta ejecución de los compromisos adquiridos.

4. Administración y seguimiento comercial

Mantener actualizado el CRM y dar seguimiento a las distintas etapas de cada oportunidad.

Supervisar el avance de contratos, órdenes de compra, facturación y cobranza en coordinación con las áreas correspondientes.

5. Reportes y control de resultados

Presentar el estatus de las cuentas y del pipeline comercial.

Elaborar reportes e indicadores de desempeño para la Dirección y seguimiento de KPIs.

Requisitos:

- Licenciatura concluida

- 2+ años trabajando en servicio a cliente B2B.

- (Deseable) Experiencia en Real Estate Comercial (retail, industrial o logístico) y/o en arrendamientos comerciales y negociación de contratos.

Otros:

- Manejo de CRM, Excel y elaboración de propuestas y presentaciones comerciales.

- Disponibilidad para realizar visitas y recorridos con clientes en la Ciudad de México y su área metropolitana (auto propio idealmente).

description:
About the job

Overview

At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.

You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.

Come make an impact every day at Zebra.

What We're Looking For

This role is responsible for driving customer satisfaction and operational efficiency by resolving complex, escalated technical issues across our industrial, mobile, and RFID printing portfolios. Utilizing deep hardware and software expertise, the successful candidate will diagnose complex print engine failures, address high-tier calibration challenges, and ensure maximum uptime for critical business environments. Additionally, you will maintain standard-setting response times and proactively contribute to the continuous improvement of the Technical Support Team’s printing diagnostic tools and processes.

Advanced Hardware & Software Troubleshooting


Hardware Maintenance: Expertly diagnose, troubleshoot, and repair print engines, label printers, and mobile printing units to significantly reduce customer downtime.
System Calibration: Configure menus, test sensors, and perform precise printhead adjustments to ensure optimal barcode and RFID readability.
Software Integration: Utilize industry-leading tools, including Zebra Setup Utilities and ZebraDesigner, for seamless device configuration and custom label design.


Customer Success & Escalation Management


Serve as the primary escalation point for resolving highly complex, diverse technical issues that require deep data analysis and critical thinking.
Deliver exceptional technical support to customers via telephone, email, and chat, demonstrating active listening and empathy in high-pressure situations.
Translate highly technical concepts into simple, easy-to-understand terms for both customers and internal management.


Leadership & Process Improvement


Act as a mentor and escalation point to support and guide less experienced agents on the team.
Develop, refine, and improve support processes, tools, and platform developments to enhance the overall customer experience.
Analyze data and prepare detailed reports on the effectiveness and efficiency of the support center.
Build and maintain strong relationships with vendors, internal technical teams, business leaders, and technology partners.


What We Are Looking For


Education: Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent vocational qualification/experience in a related technical field.
Experience: 4 to 5 years of proven experience in technical support, with a strong emphasis on hardware maintenance (printing devices, RFID, and mobile technology highly preferred).
Technical Proficiency: Full understanding of job-related procedures and intermediate to advanced skills in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).
Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; ability to provide clear, concise information using proper professional language.
Core Competencies:
Strong customer service orientation with a dedication to resolving issues effectively.
Solid professional work behaviors (attendance, teamwork, time management).
Advanced problem-solving skills and the ability to evaluate moderately complex factors.
Intermediate to advanced skills in task delegation and follow-up.

Why Join Us?

We offer a collaborative environment where your technical expertise is valued, and your career growth is supported. Help us keep the world's supply chains, hospitals, and retail floors running smoothly.

Benefits

We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success.

Job Posting Statement

To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department.

AI Technology Statement

Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. For more on how we use technology in hiring and how we process applicant data, see our Zebra Privacy Policy.

Performance & Analytics

Company Description

Kolors es una red de movilidad compartida con rutas preestablecidas que opera a través de la más avanzada tecnología y a través de la app. Estamos enfocados en brindar un servicio de calidad, cómodo y seguro, a la vez que contribuimos con la disminución del tráfico vehicular de las ciudades.

Job Description

Objetivo de la posición:

El Analista de Customer Success (CSM) es una posición junior que brinda soporte operativo y

analítico al equipo de Customer Success en la gestión de cuentas B2B y B2B2C.

Su misión es asegurar la correcta ejecución de procesos administrativos relacionados con la

cartera de clientes, contribuyendo a que el equipo de CSM pueda enfocarse en la gestión

estratégica, retención y crecimiento de las cuentas enterprise.

Esta posición tendrá interacción con diferentes áreas internas, principalmente Customer

Success, Finanzas, Operaciones y otras áreas involucradas en los procesos de facturación y

administración de clientes.

Es una posición entry level, ideal para una persona organizada, analítica, con atención al

detalle y con interés en desarrollarse profesionalmente en áreas de Customer Success,

Account Management, Operaciones o Administración B2B.

Responsabilidades principales


 Soporte al proceso de facturación B2B


Dar seguimiento al proceso de facturación de clientes B2B.

Validar información necesaria para la correcta emisión de pre facturas/cortes mensuales.

Recopilar y organizar información de consumo, servicios y condiciones comerciales.

Identificar inconsistencias o diferencias en la información de pre facturación/cortes mensuales.

Dar seguimiento con las áreas internas para resolver incidencias.

Mantener actualizada la información y documentación relacionada con cada cuenta.


 Soporte al proceso de facturación B2B2C


Dar seguimiento a los procesos de facturación correspondientes al modelo B2B2C.

Validar información y datos requeridos para la pre facturación/cortes mensuales.

Coordinar con las áreas involucradas para asegurar la correcta ejecución del proceso.

Detectar y reportar discrepancias en consumos, precios o información de facturación.

Dar seguimiento a aclaraciones y ajustes hasta su resolución.


 Solicitud y seguimiento de créditos


Gestionar solicitudes de crédito relacionadas con clientes y operaciones.

Recopilar la información y documentación necesaria para cada solicitud.

Dar seguimiento con las áreas correspondientes hasta obtener resolución.

Mantener un control actualizado del estatus de las solicitudes.

Identificar y comunicar oportunamente posibles retrasos o incidencias.

Apoyar a los CSM en tareas administrativas de sus cuentas.

Dar seguimiento a pendientes internos relacionados con las cuentas.

Contribuir a mejorar y estandarizar procesos internos del área.

Indicadores de desempeño (KPIs)

Cumplimiento de tiempos de pre facturación/cortes mensuales.

Porcentaje de pre facturas/cortes mensuales procesadas correctamente.

Tiempo de resolución de incidencias de pre facturación/cortes mensuales.

Cumplimiento de solicitudes de créditos dentro de SLA.

Cumplimiento de SLA de solicitudes internas.

Calidad y actualización de la información de las cuentas.

Número de incidencias o errores administrativos.

Nivel de soporte y satisfacción del equipo de Customer Success.

Qualifications

Perfil requerido:

Experiencia

0-2 años de experiencia profesional, incluyendo prácticas profesionales o experiencia de

becario.

Recién egresados o estudiantes de últimos semestres de carreras como Administración,

Finanzas, Contabilidad, Ingeniería Industrial, Negocios, Economía o carreras afines.

Experiencia previa en actividades administrativas, análisis de información, facturación,

operaciones o atención a clientes B2B es deseable, pero no indispensable.

Interés por desarrollarse en Customer Success, Account Management, Operaciones o áreas

relacionadas con clientes empresariales.

Competencias clave:

Organización y atención al detalle.

Capacidad analítica y manejo de información.

Seguimiento y sentido de urgencia.

Orientación a resultados.

Comunicación efectiva.

Capacidad para trabajar de manera transversal con diferentes áreas.

Proactividad y disposición para aprender.

Responsabilidad y ownership.

Capacidad para identificar errores e inconsistencias.

Manejo de Excel o Google Sheets.

Facilidad para aprender y utilizar sistemas y herramientas tecnológica.

Additional Information

Ofrecemos:

Salario competitivo + prestaciones superiores a las de ley.

Al concluir el periodo de prueba:

Total Pass

SGMM y Seguro de Vida con Insignia

Mina (Wellness)

Lunes a viernes de 09:00 a 18:00

En Kolors nos esforzamos por construir una fuerza laboral compuesta por personas con diversos antecedentes, habilidades, mentes e identidades que nos ayuden a crecer, no sólo como empresa, sino también como individuos. Continental is a leading tire manufacturer and industry specialist that develops and produces sustainable, safe and convenient solutions for automotive manufacturers as well as industrial and end customers worldwide. Founded in 1871, the company generated sales of €39.7 billion in 2024 and currently employs around 95,000 people in 54 countries and markets.

ContiTech is one of the world’s leading industry specialists. The Continental group sector offers its customers connected, environment-friendly, safe and convenient industry and service solutions using a range of materials for off-highway applications, on rails and roads, in the air, under and above the ground, in industrial environments, for the food sector and the furniture industry. With about 39,000 employees in more than 40 countries and sales of some 6.4 billion euros (2024), the global industrial partner is active with core branches in Asia, Europe and North and South America.

Experience using business communication platforms such as 8x8 or similar phone systems.

description:
About the job

Our team is looking for a strong media buyer who has experience managing $50,000 USD per month (or more) 




This is NOT your typical media buyer role where as an agency we get compensated a % of ad spend for big brands 




We are spending OUR money to send traffic to various lead generation offers and are paid a FIXED Pay Per Lead or Pay Per Sale. This means if we get paid $50 per lead and your cost per lead is $60, we lose money as a company, where the opposite means we are profitable if your cost per lead is $40 then we profit $10 per lead. 




This will require someone who 

Has extensive experience managing and optimizing campaigns on META 
Can take full responsibility for the performance of the account 
Can read and interpret KPIs and data to understand performance 
Knows and understands how to optimize campaigns, targeting, manual bidding, creatives etc. to hit target costs consistently 




You’ll receive a base salary to start, if you can prove performance then you’ll be eligible for potential bonuses etc. based on performance 




To be considered, write a 2-3 paragraph response explaining why you believe you’d be the perfect person for this role and what you will do that’s unique and separate you from most media buyers. IF you meet any of the BONUSES below, note these in an additional paragraph 




BONUS: Some things that will make you stand out as a candidate

The higher the average monthly spend you’ve managed, the better
Your experience testing unorthodox methods with duplicating campaigns, bid cap methods etc. to hit targets 
Experience with ad tracking platforms such as hyros, voluum, clickflare, redtrack etc 

 • • Knowing how to pass all data points via subids and then being able to interpret that data to optimize for deeper funnel objectives

description:
About the job

Growth Digital Marketing Manager | Polanco, CDMX




Estamos en búsqueda de un Growth Digital Marketing Manager para liderar estrategias de adquisición digital enfocadas en Atracción de Talento, conectando performance marketing, datos y tecnología para generar candidatos de calidad y convertirlos en contrataciones.

Buscamos un perfil estratégico, analítico y hands-on, con experiencia en Growth, Performance Marketing y Paid Media, capaz de transformar las necesidades de Reclutamiento en campañas, audiencias y funnels efectivos.

• Diseñar campañas de atracción de talento en Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok, LinkedIn y otros canales.

Si tienes experiencia convirtiendo estrategia digital, datos y performance en resultados reales de adquisición, nos interesa conocerte.

title: Trade Marketing Leader
description:
About the job

Summary:

Lead and oversee trade marketing efforts across all channels, including retail partners, by developing strategies to drive sell-out and expand the company's channel footprint. This role includes designing high-impact promotional campaigns, managing trade spend budgets, leading promoter field teams, and implementing shop-in-shop modules to enhance point-of-sale (POS) conversion rates.




Responsibilities & Objectives:

• New Product Introductions (NPI) & Displays: Oversee trade launch preparations for high value appliances, handling the full development of premium shop-in-shop displays, demo stations, planograms, and promotional assets.

• Trade Spend & Promotional ROI: Manage, monitor, and improve the promotional budget. Design and assess promotional bundles, trade-in offers, and seasonal campaigns (such as Buen Fin and Mother’s Day) to boost volume while maintaining margins.

• Field Force & Promoter Management: Develop incentive plans, KPI systems, and training programs for field promoters, brand advocates, and RSAs to enhance sell-out efficiency.

• Joint Business Planning (JBP) & Account Support: Collaborate with Sales on business presentations, floor-space negotiations, and customized promotional schedules for key clients.

• Budget Management: Develop, control, and oversee the Trade Marketing budget.

• Promoter Targets & Follow-up: Set sell-out goals per customer and monitor coverage.

• Sales Floor Enhancement: Improve product displays and communication efforts on the sales floor, coordinating with marketing for messaging.

• POP and Display: Develop and distribute POS materials, plan and negotiate special exhibitions and events, and organize sell-out acceleration activities.

• Promotional Communication: Ensure accurate promotion messaging on the sales floor.

• Giveaways: Secure promotional giveaway materials.

• Training: Provide training for promoters and sales staff, coordinating content development and follow-up activities.

• Event Coverage: Manage attendance at customers’ events and dealer expo coverage.

• Expenses and Reimbursements: Track and report quarterly sales floor activities and expenses for reimbursement; handle supplier invoice payments.




Experience & Background

3-5 years of work experience in a similar role in trade marketing, particularly in Consumer Electronics, Home Appliances, or high-involvement durable goods sectors.

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or a related field, with supervisory experience and advanced English skills.




Knowledge, Skills, Abilities 

• Appliance Retail Dynamics: Deep understanding of key retail channels (Consumer Electronics, Home Improvement, Department Stores, Direct-to-Consumer) and their floor share and margin expectations.

• Product Life Cycle & NPI (New Product Introduction): Mastery of launching complex, high ticket appliances, coordinating display floor readiness, sample seeding, and trade launch roadshows.

• Retailer Business Models & Trade Terms: Knowledge of sell-in vs. sell-out dynamics, joint business planning (JBP), cooperative advertising, display allowances, and floor-space negotiations.

• Shopper Journey & In-Store Experience: Expertise in high-involvement purchase paths, category management, demo station placement, and digital-physical (phygital) integration at POS.

Skills

• Promotional & Trade Spend Optimization: Designing, evaluating, and managing high-value promotional campaigns (e.g., promotional bundles, trade-in programs, seasonal peak activations) to protect gross margins.

• Promoter & Field Team Management: Designing incentive structures, training programs, and KPI tracking models for field promoters, brand advocates, and floor sales specialists (RSA - Retail Sales Associates).

• POSM & Floor Display Execution: Managing end-to-end development of premium branded shop-in-shop modules, interactive product displays, high-impact POP materials, and planograms.

• Commercial Analytics and Cross-Functional Synergy: Using sell-out data, inventory turn rates, promoter productivity metrics, and competitor share-of-shelf analysis to dynamically adjust trade plans.




We Offer:

• Benefits of the law

• Major medical insurance, Food Vauchers and more.




Confidential due to business strategy

This opportunity is being managed confidentially as part of the company's hiring strategy. Additional details will be shared with shortlisted candidates during the recruitment process.




Confidential / organizational reasons

This search is being conducted on a confidential basis due to internal organizational considerations. Complete information about the company and the role will be provided to candidates who advance in the selection process

description:
About the job

Who We Are

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About The Role

Being customer obsessed and data driven is what drives this role. We’re looking for individuals who can empathize with users, and work towards making their everyday lives easier. If you’re analytical, detail-oriented, and organized, but also excited to roll up your sleeves and get your hands dirty, you’d fit right in. The role will require rotational working hours to ensure smooth operational running of the 24/7/365 real-time set up, and collaboration with a global team. This role directly powers a critical live customer-facing product safety product, which forms the foundation for multiple other safety features. You would be the expert at risk identification, for all our customers using our safety products. You would also work closely with the Research & Development teams, to power our in-house Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence models, by generating high quality training datasets. This requires an understanding of data requirements, data definitions, edge-cases, tooling and review processes. In addition to that, you would also work closely with the Product team to run proof of concepts and experiments, which guide the direction of our Safety product suite, particularly in the areas of risk identification, mitigation, and reduction. You would also contribute toward analyzing data to improve the user experience for our customers. You’ll work a regular five‑day schedule, including day, evening and/or overnight and weekend shifts as part of a rotation. Overnight (11pm - 7am for example) shifts include enhanced compensation where applicable.

What You'll Do


Review and analyze live videos captured by Motive's dashcam for risk identification, based on the known risk factors combined with the contextual knowledge which would vary from case to case.
Adhere to the established guidelines and protocols for annotation to ensure consistency and reliability of data.
Ensure timely delivery of accurate data as per SLAs.
Consistently strive to enhance the annotation procedures and play a role in shaping the team's best practices through active participation.
Exhibit flexibility and adaptability in taking on new responsibilities beyond the scope of the defined job description, showcasing a proactive and versatile approach to work.

Preferably, a Bachelors in Computer Science, IT, Management or related field.
Detail oriented and organized, with a growth mindset.
Thinks, designs and executes keeping customers at the center of the solution.
Interested in learning about the annotation landscape and application of AI/ML in the trucking industry.
Ability to work collaboratively, in a 24/7/365 set up, with strong context in between them.
The position requires working day, evening and overnight shifts and weekends, while maintaining a standard five-day work week overall.
Good communication skills, oral and written.

description:
About the job

Company Description CMF Global, Inc. is a California-based manufacturer and supplier of pipes, valves, and fittings for a wide range of global applications, and also provides micro- and mini-hydroelectric power generating equipment. The company owns several sustainable branded products, including AquaFuse, ControlFlo, and AquaFuse Liner, which are specified on major infrastructure projects worldwide. CMF Global specializes in international consolidation and shipping, helping customers streamline procurement and reduce total costs. CMF Global has been recognized with regional Exporter of the Year awards and holds multiple Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) and Disadvantaged Business Enterprise (DBE) certifications. 

SUMMARY

The International Sales Support Specialist provides administrative, technical, customer service, and business development support for CMF Global's international sales efforts. This role works closely with the VP of Sales & Marketing, international distributors, contractors, consultants, and internal departments to support sales growth, improve customer experience, coordinate project activities, and strengthen CMF Global's international market presence.




The position is designed to support and enhance international sales activities, allowing senior sales personnel to focus on business development, relationship management, and strategic growth initiatives.




Role Description the International Sales Support Specialist is a full-time remote role responsible for supporting global sales activities and customer accounts. This role assists with coordinating international orders, documentation, and shipping logistics to ensure accurate and timely deliveries. The specialist responds to customer inquiries, prepares quotations, maintains sales records, and supports export financing processes in collaboration with internal teams. Daily tasks include communicating with international clients, distributors, and partners, tracking order status, and resolving issues related to products, pricing, and delivery. The role also involves collaborating with sales and operations teams to improve processes, support bid and proposal preparation, and contribute to a positive customer experience across international markets.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES The following are essential duties and responsibilities of the position; this list is not exhaustive and may include other tasks as assigned:




International Sales Support

Support international distributors, contractors, consultants, and customers with sales-related activities and inquiries.
Assist with the preparation, coordination, and delivery of international quotations and project proposals.
Coordinate with the Quotes and Estimating Team to ensure quotations are accurate, complete, and delivered on a timely basis.
Track outstanding quotations, project opportunities, and lead follow-up and communication activities.
Maintain accurate project, customer, and opportunity information within company systems.
Assist in identifying and qualifying international sales opportunities.




Customer and Distributor Support

Build and maintain positive relationships with international distributors, consultants, contractors, and end users.
Support distributor development initiatives and customer engagement activities.
Assist customers with product information, technical documentation, and application support.
Coordinate communication between customers and internal departments to ensure timely responses and resolution of issues.
Support efforts to improve customer satisfaction and overall customer experience.

Assist with training preparation, documentation, and logistics.
Coordinate with Technical Sales Managers and Trainers to support customer training requirements.
Assist customers and internal teams in identifying technical concerns and coordinating appropriate resources for resolution.




Market Development and Relationship Building

Participate in trade shows, industry events, customer visits, and distributor meetings as assigned.
Assist with specification development efforts by supporting consultant and influencer relationships.

Marketing and Business Support

EXPERIENCE

· Experience supporting customers, distributors, contractors, consultants, or project-based sales activities preferred.

· Experience with quotations, project coordination, customer service, technical support, or sales support functions preferred.

Industry & Business Experience

Location: Remote




micro1 is engaging Video Editors to contribute expertise to a dynamic project focused on educational and robotics media for AI training. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. This opportunity centers on 3D/CGI video editing and animation, leveraging your visual storytelling skills to create impactful digital media content.

Edit and assemble high-quality 3D/CGI video content using any tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or Avid Media Composer.

Organize and manage complex project files in line with modern post-production workflows and remote collaboration best practices.
Incorporate feedback efficiently to iterate on assets and align deliverables with project goals and client needs.

Extensive experience editing 3D/CGI and animation-based content within professional environments or client projects.
Proficiency with any leading video and audio production tools: Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, Avid Media Composer.
Demonstrable skills in visual storytelling, animation, motion graphics, and computer vision for media projects.
Strong written and verbal communication abilities, especially in remote and asynchronous collaborative contexts.
Meticulous attention to detail and a solid foundation in project organization and post-production workflows.
Proven ability to integrate feedback and deliver highly polished, technically sound multimedia assets on deadline.
Bachelor’s degree in any field is required; advanced experience in video editing, digital media, visual effects, or related areas is highly valued.

description:
About the job

We’re a performance creative + paid social and search agency working with DTC brands, and we’re hiring an Operations Manager (PPC & Paid Social) to own our delivery pipeline from intake to final execution.

If you love structure, clarity, and making media buying and account management teams run smoother, this is for you.




What You’ll Be Responsible For

You will own the full operational flow across all Paid Search (PPC) and Paid Social accounts, serving as the operational backbone for our strategists and account managers:




Task Management & Execution Pipeline

Own account workflows: Oversee task management across all accounts, creating, assigning, scheduling, and following up on all deliverables.
Translate direction: Convert client requests, meeting notes, and strategist direction into clear, structured tasks complete with owners, firm deadlines, and necessary context.
Delegate & balance: Monitor team workloads, manage dependencies, and balance capacity across media buyers and specialists.
Maintain momentum: Track upcoming deadlines to spot bottlenecks or delivery risks early and make sure nothing gets stuck.
Workflow Coordination & Quality Assurance
Manage core account processes: Coordinate key PPC and Paid Social workflows, including client onboarding, platform/asset access requests, tracking setup, campaign launches, and testing calendars.
Cross-functional follow-up: Proactively follow up across internal teams and clients to ensure all required inputs are received on time so work moves forward seamlessly.
System & SOP maintenance: Keep ClickUp, internal SOPs, and account documentation organized, accurate, and up to date.
Visibility & Process Improvement
Central hub: Serve as the central point of contact between strategists, media buyers, performance managers, and clients.
Status tracking & escalation: Provide clear visibility into project status, overdue work, capacity concerns, and escalate issues only when necessary.
Optimize operations: Notice gaps or inefficiencies in delivery workflows immediately and help standardize or improve processes.

You’re a Fit If You:

Have 3+ years in digital marketing operations, media agency project management, or delivery operations.
Have experience coordinating teams, media buyers, or execution specialists in PPC and Paid Social environments.
Are extremely detail-oriented and process-driven.
Communicate clearly, confidently, and professionally in English (C1 level or higher required).
Are comfortable pushing back internally and externally to protect deadlines and maintain standards.
Notice inefficiencies immediately and proactively fix them.
Don’t need daily direction to fully own a function.

We’re looking for someone who can run the delivery machine so our strategists can focus on high-level growth strategy.




Why This Role Matters

Right now, project management and workflow oversight for PPC and Paid Social are spread across multiple strategists and team members. We need a single owner to centralize accountability, streamline campaign launches, improve delivery times, and protect leadership bandwidth as we scale.




Ready for your next move? We’d love to hear from you! Please email hiring@taikundigital.com with your resume, LinkedIn link, and a short intro telling us why you're a fit for the role. Use the subject line: "Paid Media Operations Manager position."
